description: The bar chart illustrates average joint goal accuracy (Avg. JGA Score) across dialogue turns (Turn ID) for two models, comparing LLaMA-7B and T5-small at each turn. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Turn ID,” shown in ascending order at even-numbered turns from 0 through 26 (0, 2, 4, …, 26) on a linear categorical spacing. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” using a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks from 0.2 up to 1.0 at regular 0.1 intervals. For each Turn ID, there are two adjacent vertical bars: an orange bar for “LLaMA-7B” and a yellow bar for “T5-small,” as indicated by the legend in the upper-right. Approximate bar heights for LLaMA-7B are about 0.96 (Turn 0), 0.92 (2), 0.88 (4), 0.83 (6), 0.77 (8), 0.75 (10), 0.73 (12), 0.69 (14), 0.67 (16), 0.61 (18), 0.65 (20), 0.60 (22), 0.65 (24), and 0.44 (26). Corresponding T5-small values are about 0.95 (Turn 0), 0.84 (2), 0.71 (4), 0.61 (6), 0.59 (8), 0.51 (10), 0.46 (12), 0.48 (14), 0.47 (16), 0.48 (18), 0.43 (20), 0.42 (22), 0.30 (24), and 0.33 (26). The bars are not visually emphasized with annotations or outlines beyond their distinct colors, and the ordering follows the Turn ID sequence rather than sorting by bar height.
